title: lock patterns now read SRD/**/.edm-state.lock and .lockd/ and match the lockbase-derived names with_state_lock creates at edm-state:817-818; audit-patterns lock covered by .gitignore:13-14
the canonical-sections backup now lands in $TMP and cleanup_wave6 restores the tracked file on EXIT INT TERM (wave6-smoke.sh:20-29, :3134-3136)
wave7 now has a suite-level TMP plus trap EXIT INT TERM and all 15 scratch sites route through it; wave6's nine fake-HOME trees are inside $TMP and no literal /tmp remains in _harness.sh or timing.sh
the destination write is now mktemp "${DST}.tmp.XXXXXX" plus trap EXIT INT TERM plus mv -f, so the byte-compared generated file can no longer be observed half-written

the attribution pattern file is hoisted to script scope with a trap on the next line and lands in ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}, so the hot commit-hook path enters the leak window once per process instead of once per initiative
L5 half fixed: all five staging writers now go through one trapped write_atomic helper using mktemp rather than $$, which also tests the destination directory for writability rather than the file
L5 half fixed: the mktemp template now ends in Xs and honours TMPDIR, so --self-test no longer dies on BSD/macOS; the RETURN-only trap residue is ephemeral-mount only

the du gate is now scoped to tracked bytes but evals/runs/ still has no retention policy in code or in evals/README.md, so every local invocation adds three claude -p payloads plus stderr logs and nothing prunes
no test asserts that .gitignore covers the lock and temp names edm-state derives from lockbase, which is why the same unmatched-pattern defect shipped in EDMV2 and again in EDMV3 round 1

three ignore patterns are anchored to the literal SRD/ prefix while srd_root relocation is documented and supported, so a relocated tree re-exposes the lock files and the findings-ledger/HANDOFF staging files as untracked
canonical-sections.md.tmp.XXXXXX is the only staging path in the plugin no .gitignore glob matches -- the prescribed plugins/edm/docs/*.tmp.* line was never added, and the trap omits HUP

the scorer unconditionally writes scores.json into whatever directory it is given and the fixture README documents pointing it at the tracked bin/tests/fixtures/code-audit/, which already deposited an untracked file there
the prescribed rm -f of the flock file was deliberately not applied and should stay unapplied -- unlinking a released flock file breaks mutual exclusion; add a comment so round 3 does not re-fix it

timing.sh still carries no trap on any of its six modes and --generate-fixture prints no teardown line, but every scratch tree now honours TMPDIR so the residue is bounded ephemeral disk, never git status
three mktemp files with inline rm -f and no trap anywhere in the file, all under ${TMPDIR:-/tmp} and tiny, on a path whose assertion helpers never exit early
the four scratch artifacts deleted earlier this session have not reappeared and the code-audit fixture directory contains exactly its 24 committed files with no stray scorer output
